title: Second Marriage
summary: An unlimited-use wand that summons Connor Vinderblad as an undead thrall.

fields.Summon: Action, up to 60 ft. Summon controllable Connor for 10 turns. No recharge. Can summon him again after he dies. Casting does not break stealth.
fields.Acquisition: Use Bitter Divorce to raise Connor and retain the wand under the applicable Save Mayrina outcome.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
